on_screen_text.text: Unearthed Trump clip: I actually think the president would be blamed for a shutdown

spoken_summary: In an interview, Donald Trump states his belief that if a government shutdown occurs, the president would be blamed. He calls a shutdown a "tremendously negative mark on the president of the United States," adding that the president is the one who "has to get people together." The interviewer interjects to clarify that it would be a "partial shutdown."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of the dialogue from the interview clip, with no background music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, uncut clip of a talking-head interview. Text overlays and captions are added, but the underlying video is static.
central_claim: Donald Trump previously stated on record that the president is to blame for any government shutdown.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as hypocritical by highlighting his past statements about presidential responsibility for government shutdowns.
